About Organization

Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited is a government-owned telecommunications company in India. It was incorporated on 15 September 2000.

BSNL provides a wide range of services, including wireline, wireless, and internet services.

About the Programme

The BSNL Junior Telecom Officer JTO Recruitment 2026 aims to recruit eligible candidates for the post of Junior Telecom Officer.

The programme is designed to provide opportunities for Indian citizens to work with Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited and contribute to the growth of the telecommunications sector in India.
